data.outcome_summary: ICCS 2016 Rapport Vlaanderen is a national end report for the International Civic and Citizenship Education Study (ICCS 2016) implemented in the Flemish Community. The study collected data in 162 schools from Feb–Apr 2016, involving 2,931 students (about 14-year-olds / Grade 8 equivalent), 2,021 teachers (randomly selected ~15 per school), and 149 school directors. The report uses ICCS instruments to measure political knowledge (IRT-scaled test), civic attitudes and norms (e.g., conventional/social/moral citizenship, political trust, tolerance and gender equality), participation intentions and school participation opportunities, and school climate outcomes such as bullying reports. For international comparisons, it applies IEA response-rate quality exclusions, resulting in 21 countries for student analyses and fewer countries for teacher and school director analyses. The excerpted text does not describe any machine-learning predictive modeling; instead, it reports descriptive comparisons and regression-based associations, with individual-level assigned weights used in regression models, while PV handling and missing-data procedures are not documented in the provided sections.
